'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship Matthew Perry LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Perry]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Wookiee Rage
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
